title: SGMC资本Mohit：印尼精选复苏标的，悲观与怀疑间布局
speaker: Mohit Mipuri

segments.en: I would not say buy everything. I would say this is still a selective recovery market.
segments.zh: 我不会说买入一切。我会说这仍然是一个选择性复苏的市场。

segments.en: You want quality balance sheets, strong cash flows, credible governance.
segments.zh: 你需要优质的资产负债表、强劲的现金流、可信的治理。

segments.en: A lot of stocks are export oriented dollar earners and they have free cash flow generation above 20%.
segments.zh: 很多标的都是出口导向的美元收入者，自由现金流生成率超过20%。

segments.en: A lot of them actually trade at price to earnings under 7-8 times, low single digits and even under one time price to book.
segments.zh: 很多标的市盈率低于7-8倍，低个位数，甚至市净率低于1倍。

segments.en: There's a famous market line as well, right? Bold markets are born on pessimism and grow on skepticism.
segments.zh: 还有一句著名的市场格言：牛市生于悲观，长于怀疑。

segments.en: Right now, we are definitely in between that pessimism and skepticism phase.
segments.zh: 现在，我们正处于悲观和怀疑阶段之间。

segments.en: It's definitely not euphoric by any means.
segments.zh: 这绝对不是任何意义上的狂热。
